verdict.rationale: The PlayCanvas Engine is published on GitHub as an open-source game engine, and a runtime probe confirms it is MIT-licensed on npm. Community comments independently describe it as open source, and the editor MCP server and SuperSplat Viewer are also open source. The browser-based Editor, a major part of the product, is not shown to be open-source anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: evidence that the Editor's own source is under an open license, and first-party license documentation beyond the probe's MIT note.
